# Committee meeting notes

- [2026-08-11](2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md): Odile will repaint the noticeboard; Paolo will move shed lights to the night rate; Nell will ask the city about a second tap.
- [2026-08-26](2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md): Paolo completed the night-rate change; Nell will continue pursuing the second-tap enquiry.
- [2026-09-08](2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md): The committee agreed to replace the shed roof; Ibrahim will send fee reminders; the gate latch remains unfixed.
- [2026-09-22](2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md): The committee chose the $1,480 roof quote; Nell will order compost; Dov will take over the second-tap enquiry.
- [2026-10-06](2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md): Paolo booked the roofer; Wren will replace the gate latch; Tessa will draft a winter-closing checklist.
- [2026-10-20](2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md): Work day was set for 14 November; Paolo will query the roof invoice’s extra $80; Dov will chase the city about the second tap.
- [2026-11-03](2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md): The roof invoice will remain unpaid pending clarification; work-day arrangements were confirmed; there will be no further meetings in 2026.
